name: Tool — File search
summary: FileSearchTool with a pre-uploaded vector store, attached to a BYOM-routed agent.
description: `FileSearchTool` attaches an existing vector store to a Prompt Agent whose orchestrator model is BYOM-routed. The tool uses platform-managed embeddings, so users route only the answer-generating agent model through APIM AI Gateway.
notes:
`test.py` creates a fresh vector store + file per run, attaches it to a Prompt Agent with a BYOM-prefixed model, invokes it, then deletes both — no environment wiring needed. Vector store creation and file attach succeed, and BYOM chat calls reach APIM as `POST /inference/deployments/gpt-4o-mini/chat/completions` (200). However, invoking the agent that has `FileSearchTool` attached with a BYOM-prefixed model returns:

> Error code: 500 - server_error. Please include the request ID ... in your message.

APIM shows only the chat-completion turn (200 OK), so the failure is on Foundry's side while assembling the file-search retrieval into the BYOM-routed run. The card previously claimed `supported` — flipping to `partial` until Foundry either fixes the 500 or documents a workaround.
